title: Defense Budget
subtitle: You have 100 units. Save what you can — not everything can be saved.
whyThisMatters: No team can fund everything at once. The tradeoff you make on a quiet day is the defense you have on a bad day — this exercise makes the cost of leaving a gap feel real before an attacker finds it.
rememberThis: Every control covers someone else's blind spot — you don't need to buy everything, but you need to know what you left open and how you'll catch it another way.

controls.name: Phishing Drills & Crew Huddles
controls.description: Monthly phishing simulations + toolbox talks so crew spot lookalike domains, urgency tricks, and anonymous Teams banners.
controls.helpsWith: Catches display-name spoofs, external-vendor bank-change lures, and 'don't tell Finance' pressure before anyone clicks.

controls.name: Advanced Email Gateway
controls.description: Attachment sandbox, lookalike-domain flagging, and SPF/DMARC enforcement that quarantines risky mail before it reaches an inbox.
controls.helpsWith: Flags hr@synergymarine-group-careers.com and double-extension .pdf.exe before crew ever see them.

controls.name: Fleet-wide MFA
controls.description: Phishing-resistant MFA on email, crew portal, and Teams — a stolen password alone no longer opens the door.
controls.helpsWith: Stops a harvested portal password from smishing or link-theft being usable on the real account.

controls.name: Endpoint Detection & Response
controls.description: Behavioural EDR on every workstation that kills macro-launched PowerShell and alerts SOC on C2 beacons.
controls.helpsWith: Blocks Payslip_March.pdf.exe even after open — macro → PowerShell → external beacon never leaves the host.

controls.name: DNS Filter & Perimeter Firewall
controls.description: DNS filtering + egress firewall that blocks known-bad domains and C2 destinations at the boundary.
controls.helpsWith: Stops a clicked bit.ly/CrewRotation or portal-synergymarine-group-secure.net beacon even if the mail got through.

controls.name: Immutable Daily Backups
controls.description: Immutable, tested daily backups with offline restore drills — the undo button when prevention fails.
controls.helpsWith: Restores crew manifests and payroll shares after a ransomware lock without paying.

controls.name: IR Retainer & Playbooks
controls.description: 24-hour IR retainer, clear reporting line, and Finance's 'no wire without callback' approval chain.
controls.helpsWith: Turns a suspicious 'CSO says don't loop Finance' Teams DM into a reported, contained near-miss before money moves.

scenarios.title: HR Recruitment Lure — Lookalike Domain
scenarios.description: Same chain as Live Simulation 01: public LinkedIn crew lists predict firstname.lastname@synergymarinegroup.com and deliver a CV-lure from hr@synergymarine-group-careers.com.
scenarios.narrative: Attacker scrapes 18 public LinkedIn profiles, predicts the email format, and sends an offer-letter lure from a lookalike career domain via external relay (SPF soft-fail). HR is ideal because they expect attachments from strangers.

outcomeNotes.Awareness/Human: HR trained to check the exact domain character-by-character catches the added "-careers" before replying with passport and bank details.
outcomeNotes.Email Security: Gateway flags the lookalike domain and external relay SPF soft-fail and quarantines it before inbox.
outcomeNotes.Identity & Access (MFA): No login step here — nothing for MFA to protect.
outcomeNotes.Endpoint/EDR: No payload executed yet — endpoint never engaged.
outcomeNotes.Network/Perimeter: No C2 or portal call to block at the boundary.
outcomeNotes.Incident Response: Reporting helps after the fact, but without the first two layers the lure already landed.

scenarios.title: Payslip Macro — Double-Extension Beacon
scenarios.description: Same lure as Live Simulation 02: a reused payslip subject delivers Payslip_March.pdf.exe and Documents.zip (pwd:1234) asking crew to 'Enable Content'.
scenarios.narrative: Subject copied from a legitimate roster mail. Inside: a macro document. Enable Content → PowerShell → external C2 beacon from WIN-HR-LT042. HR payroll lateral risk: crew PII + bank details from shared drive.

outcomeNotes.Awareness/Human: Pausing on unexpected type (EXE/ZIP) and not enabling macros stops the payload before it runs.
outcomeNotes.Email Security: Sandbox flags double-extension .pdf.exe and password-protected ZIP before delivery.
outcomeNotes.Identity & Access (MFA): No identity step — MFA not in play.
outcomeNotes.Endpoint/EDR: Behavioural kill chain catches macro → PowerShell → beacon even after the file is opened.
outcomeNotes.Network/Perimeter: Egress DNS/firewall blocks the external C2 domain even if endpoint missed the beacon for a heartbeat.
outcomeNotes.Backup & Recovery: No file encryption here — backup restores nothing yet.
outcomeNotes.Incident Response: Post-execution reporting matters, but this is a seconds-scale block, not a reporting play.

scenarios.title: Smish + Wire Fraud → Ransomware Lock
scenarios.description: Adapts Live Simulation 03–04 into one chain: offshore smish via bit.ly + anonymous Teams, then a spoofed CSO ProtonMail wire push ($48,500), with a ransomware lock as fallback if the wire is refused.
scenarios.narrative: Day 5 SMS + Teams 'link only, don't call vessel manager, portal closes 18:00'. Day 6 spoofed CSO via ProtonMail CC's external vendor bank-invoice. If Finance hesitates, a parallel macro payload locks the payroll share and shows a payment countdown.

outcomeNotes.Awareness/Human: Noticing the Teams 'External' banner + no org tag, hovering to see portal-synergymarine-group-secure.net, and recognizing 'don't loop Finance' as a tactic breaks the chain.
outcomeNotes.Email Security: Core thrust is SMS + Teams + ProtonMail display spoof — outside the email gateway's main lane.
outcomeNotes.Identity & Access (MFA): Stolen portal creds from the fake rotation link are useless — MFA stops reuse on the real account.
outcomeNotes.Endpoint/EDR: If the fallback ransomware lock runs, EDR contains the PowerShell encryption before fleet-wide spread.
outcomeNotes.Network/Perimeter: Ransomware detonates locally from the already-opened macro — perimeter never sees a network intrusion to block.
outcomeNotes.Backup & Recovery: Immutable tested restore brings the payroll share back without paying, even after a lock.
outcomeNotes.Incident Response: Finance's reporting + callback-on-known-number approval chain stops the wire before $48,500 leaves — the defined IR play.
